text.en:
Item (e), page 212, subparagraph (6), for the Province of Bataan, paragraph f, section two of Republic Act Numbered Nineteen hundred is hereby amended to read as follows:
"(e) Pantalan Luma-Wawa Streets, Orani Improvement ₱2,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: March 15, 1960.
